title: Meet the customer
text: Each round one player is the customer and picks who they are today.

title: Glue two cards together
text: Everyone else glues two word cards from their hand into a product.

title: Pitch it out loud
text: Take turns pitching your product to the customer. Sell it with everything you've got!

title: The customer buys one
text: The customer buys their favourite. The other sellers also vote for a crowd favourite.
